summary: Nine-phase plan created for repair V1 (beta-priority rule selection in intStepBranch). Waves: [1] additive intStepBranchPrio + isWorldCreating + none-iff bridge + strengthened extraction bridge; [2] re-base the six proofs that unfold intStepBranch onto a shared IStepShape predicate, still over the old stepper, behavior unchanged; [3] the call-site swap in intExpandBranches.go PLUS goRaw and the #guard_msgs reconciliation, declared atomic-batch; [4] promote phiRef4 and re-point the BetaSplitRefutation narrative, IN PARALLEL WITH [5] the freeze lemma; [6] snapshot-free IReuseContain re-threaded through the key induction, replacing IReuseContain_mono; [7] augmented-frame positive persistence export; [8] discharge openBranch_countermodel; [9] the downstream Completeness sorries plus the 606 handoff record. TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE RESEARCH REPORT, both verified against the tree. (a) The report's 'three spec lemmas' undercounts: 13 intStepBranch_* lemmas exist and SIX unfold the definition directly, two of them the intExpMeasure termination lemmas -- hence the dedicated re-basing Phase 2 before the swap. (b) The report defers the BetaSplitRefutation update to last, but it cannot be deferred at all: CslibTests is the declared testDriver and goRaw calls the library intStepBranch while branchesAgree compares against the real intuitionisticTableau, so the swap flips that assertion false immediately. Test reconciliation moved into Phase 3. Phase 3 is the standalone-valuable milestone (verdict-preserving, fewer worlds, no new proof debt). Plan passes validate-artifact.sh --strict with zero warnings.

artifacts.summary: Nine phases, ~15 hours, waves [[1],[2],[3],[4,5],[6],[7],[8],[9]]. Verification tiers: interface, full, full, local, local, full, interface, full, interface. Phase 3 is the only atomic-batch phase. Five phases carry Scope Hypothesis lines.

decisions_made: Adopted V1 (beta-priority) per the research report's recommendation. V2 (retract-on-violation) is recorded as the escalation path if the Phase 5 freeze lemma fails; V3 (cyclic edges) is a measured dead end and is a named non-goal.

Split the report's step 1 into three phases (1: additive definitions and bridges; 2: re-base the six unfolding proofs; 3: the swap). Rationale: six proofs in Scheme.lean unfold intStepBranch directly, including the two intExpMeasure decrease lemmas that carry go's termination measure. Re-basing them onto a shared IStepShape predicate while still on the OLD stepper keeps the tree green and behavior-identical, which makes the swap itself a small edit and surfaces any re-basing difficulty before the calculus changes.

Strengthened the extraction bridge with `sf notin e` relative to the existing intStepBranch_some_exists. The termination lemmas currently obtain that fact by unfolding; exporting it is what lets them stop unfolding.

Moved the CslibTests reconciliation from the report's final phase into Phase 3 alongside the swap, and declared Phase 3 Commit Mode: atomic-batch (pre-declared, per the anti-abuse guard). goRaw calls the library intStepBranch and branchesAgree compares its output against the real intuitionisticTableau, so the swap and the test update are inseparable -- any boundary drawn between them is red by construction.

Split the report's step 2 into Phase 5 (freeze lemma, additive, green standalone) and Phase 6 (the IReuseContain restatement plus the re-thread that removes IReuseContain_mono from roughly six induction sites). The freeze lemma is the one genuinely new proof obligation and is worth isolating so a failure there does not also strand the restatement.

Split the report's step 4 into Phase 8 (openBranch_countermodel) and Phase 9 (the downstream Completeness sites), because Phase 8 is a heavy proof in 605's territory while Phase 9 is small and carries the 606 handoff obligation.

Gave Phase 4 (comment/docstring/test-promotion) verification tier `local` rather than `prose`: it promotes phiRef4 to a live #guard_msgs assertion, which is a real compile surface, exactly the prose tier's declared blind spot.

Recorded the report's own line numbers as approximate throughout. The report was produced in a worktree pinned to HEAD while a concurrent session edited Scheme.lean; IReuseContain is at :6814 today, not the report's :6798. Every phase re-locates its targets by symbol name.
dead_ends: Do not pursue V3 (appending the loop-back edge to the algorithm's own edges list). Measured: the 20-row conformance corpus did not terminate within ~25 minutes at real fuel where baseline and V1/V2 each finished under ~10. It also destroys the forest property that ForestComparable, IWorldsPlanted and IPosPersistRaw are stated against, and its positive-propagation across the loop-back is the same shape as the already-recorded UNSOUND 'Option B'.

Do not sequence the BetaSplitRefutation.lean update after the proof-side phases as the research report proposes. goRaw calls the library intStepBranch and branchesAgree compares against the real intuitionisticTableau, so that ordering leaves Phases 3 through 8 red.

Do not rely on the small-fuel growth table (fuels 10/16/22/28) as termination evidence. The report ran it and found it uninformative under per-branch fuel -- it measures the fuel-0 cutoff, not saturation. The real evidence is conformance row 20, the complexity-9 divergence witness, returning OPEN at intFuelExt.
Do not weaken IReuseContain to make Phase 6 close. If the Phase 5 freeze lemma resists, escalate to V2, which is a re-plan rather than an in-phase pivot.

Do not re-attempt the five excluded frame constructions (rawEdges itself, pruning at blocked worlds, pruning at strictly-blocked worlds, the greatest IFimpAccess-supported fixpoint, the maximal atom-inclusion frame). All are post-hoc constructions over unchanged algorithm output and are orthogonal to changing the algorithm.
coordination_notes: Task 605's handoff supplies three facts this plan depends on, all folded into the Coordination with Task 605 section. (1) Its Phase 2 lands openBranch_rawEdges_both_upward_closed, returning BOTH upward-closure facts at one shared edges -- Phase 8 consumes that rather than re-deriving hbuc.

(2) 605 refuted this task's research report on the DP-3 one-liner. The report gives `exact h Nat (intExtractValuation _b) _huc 0`; that does not typecheck, because IValid quantifies World : Type v while the countermodel frame is Nat : Type 0. DP-3 needs 605's .{_, 0} universe pin and its mvalid_descend / mvalid_universe_invariant ULift transport. Phase 9 is written against 605's correction, and this is recorded as a risk row. If 605 has not landed, building that transport is a scope increase to surface rather than absorb.

(3) Under 605's option A the Minimal/Completeness.lean DP-4 site is ALREADY CLOSED by 605. Phase 9 treats it as conditional and carries a Scope Hypothesis saying so; only the intuitionistic DP-3 site is certainly this task's work.

Territory in Scheme.lean is disjoint but shared-file, with one deliberate overlap: 609 owns the intStepBranch / intExpandBranches.go rule-selection region and the IReuseContain threading; 605 owns the isAccessible monotonicity region, openBranch_rawEdges_upward_closed, and openBranch_countermodel / tableau_complete at the end of the file. Phase 8 of this plan reaches into 605's region. Whichever task lands second rebases rather than re-applies.

For task 606: the reconciliation surface is the arity of openBranch_countermodel's existential (three conjuncts once 605 lands, two before) and which Completeness sites are already closed. Phase 8 detects the landed shape before proving, and Phase 9 records the resulting state explicitly for 606.

Also for task 606: its description forbids discharging DP-3 with the one-liner because that would launder an undischarged conjunct. That prohibition's PREMISE (the conjunct is open) becomes false once Phase 8 lands. Phase 9 must rewrite the in-source note at Intuitionistic/Completeness.lean:164-170 to record why the prohibition dissolved, not silently delete it -- a reader who finds the one-liner with no explanation cannot distinguish honest discharge from laundering.

ROADMAP.md's 'Propositional tableau completeness (3 sorries)' row names this task as owner of the root cause. Completing this plan retires the Scheme.lean sorry and unblocks the two Completeness.lean sorries in that row. ROADMAP.md was consulted read-only and not modified.
